name: strapi-headless-cms
title: Tarla Journal — Strapi 5 headless CMS + static frontend
description: Strapi 5 (TypeScript, SQLite) exposing articles/categories/authors over a public REST API, with public permissions and seed content created programmatically on first boot, plus a build-free static HTML/JS frontend served by nginx.

env.name: APP_KEYS
env.description: Comma-separated session keys (demo values in cms/.env.example; generate with openssl rand -base64 32)

env.name: CORS_ORIGIN
env.description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the API

auth.description: Strapi admin panel (/admin) with JWT login via POST /admin/login. Public REST reads (find/findOne on article, category, author) are granted to the anonymous public role at boot; writes require an admin session or API token.

persistence: SQLite at cms/.tmp/data.db (Docker volume cms_data at /opt/app/.tmp) auto-created and seeded on first boot; uploads in cms/public/uploads (Docker volume cms_uploads).
notes: Two services: Strapi on 1337 (main) and the static frontend on 8009 (nginx, `frontend/` dir; locally any static server works). The admin user is NOT created automatically: after the first start run scripts/create-admin.sh (local) or scripts/create-admin.sh --docker (compose), or complete the form shown on the first visit to /admin. Health endpoint /_health returns 204 (not 200). The CMS Docker build compiles better-sqlite3 on alpine and takes several minutes. If the frontend is not served from localhost, set window.API_URL in frontend/config.js to the public CMS URL and set CORS_ORIGIN accordingly. Demo secrets are provided as compose fallbacks; override via cms/.env for real deployments.
